description: SCAR (MICRO 2024, arXiv:2405.00790) evaluates ten multi-model scenarios: five inspired by MLPerf Inference (datacenter multi-tenancy) and five by XRBench (AR/VR edge). This file is a course-scale CNN subset using only models with MAESTRO CSVs in-tree (ResNet-50, MobileNetV2). It is representative, not a full reproduction of SCAR's suites (which also include LLMs and XR pipelines).

scenarios.note: Two CNNs of different scales sharing bandwidth (MLPerf-style diversity, simplified).
Both jobs use WS-style NVDLA mapping on different networks.
Heterogeneous dataflows on ResNet-50 layers (SCAR motivation: different layers favor different dataflows).
XRBench-style edge: smaller MobileNet stage + early ResNet stage (latency-friendly pair).
Deeper layers, higher BW demand on one path (stress shared DRAM).
